description: The pie chart presents the distribution of items across topical categories, showing 12 slices in total with labels and percentage values connected by leader lines (no separate legend is shown, and no slice appears exploded or otherwise emphasized). The largest slice is an unlabeled blue segment at approximately 24.3%. Other slices include Econ. & Fin. (teal) at 18.4%, History (yellow) at 8.2%, Game&Anime (orange) at 8.2%, Daily Life (light cyan) at 7.1%, Med & Health (green) at 6.7%, Science (light blue) at 6.7%, Business (red) at 5.9%, Pet & Animal (light orange) at 5.5%, Law (pink) at 5.1%, Geography (yellow-gold) at 2.7%, and Math (green) at 1.2%. The slices are arranged around the circle without an explicitly stated ordering, though the 24.3% segment is visually prominent due to its size.
